meta.name: oalders-docker
meta.description: Docker CLI mixin: the CLI plugins dir (/usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins — where `docker compose` and `docker buildx` actually live) plus a narrow read-only slice of ~/.docker (contexts, config.json). No home path is granted for write: buildx state is redirected into the worktree via BUILDX_CONFIG in bin/nn (#1004), so the mixin has no write that outlives the session. Reaching the daemon takes two grants that cover different syscalls: allow_file covers open() on the socket node, and unix_socket covers connect(AF_UNIX). The unix_socket entries are load-bearing now that nono default-denies AF_UNIX pathname connects (the mediation that closes #1003) — without them every connect() to /run/docker.sock is blocked. Security tradeoff, accepted: a session that can reach the socket can `docker run --privileged -v /:/host` to host root, so this mixin is a deliberate escape hatch scoped to the sessions that load it, not a global grant. Net-free: image pulls run in the daemon outside the sandbox, so nothing traverses the session proxy.
